title: Retire scaffolding that loses a controlled experiment
narrative: Taloneth treats an orchestration scaffold as temporary. When a with-versus-without experiment shows the scaffold hurts the primary metric, it is retired so task semantics stay the same without fossil prompts. Accepts inspiration requirement 1[^insp-r01].
implementation: `HarnessExperiment` / `HarnessExperimentRunner` in `mechaharness.harness_experiment` express interventions as hypotheses with expected metrics, compare with/without arms, and list retirement candidates. Integrates with `ResearchLab` for offline evaluation. Trace fields expose experiment id, harness version, and assignment.
validation: Harness `evaluation_research` op `harness_experiment_retire`. Soft expects: treatment worse than control yields `retired` status and a retirement candidate. Related: `taloneth_atk_research_reject`. Unit: `tests/test_inspiration_primitives.py`.
